entities.summary: Wesley JaMarr Johnson is an American professional basketball coach and former player who is a player development assistant for the Los Angeles Clippers of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Iowa State Cyclones and Syracuse Orange. He was selected by the Minnesota Timberwolves with the fourth overall pick in the 2010 NBA draft.
